**Example 1: Authenticating and retrieving gift data.**

This example demonstrates the authentication flow and then retrieves gift data by ID.

```typescript
async function getGiftData(apiToken: string, apiId: string, darilaId: string) {
  // Authenticate (first API call)
  await client.get_app_api_apiToken_apiId_({ apiToken, apiId });

  // Retrieve gift data
  const giftData = await client.get_app_api_darila_darilaId_({ darilaId });
  return giftData;
}

// Example usage:
const gift = await getGiftData("YOUR_API_TOKEN", "YOUR_API_ID", "123");
console.log(gift);
```

**Example 2: Retrieving company data by timestamp.**

This example shows how to retrieve company data using a timestamp.

```typescript
async function getCompanyData(podjetjeTimestamp: string) {
  const companyData = await client.get_app_api_podjetje_podjetjeTimestamp_({ podjetjeTimestamp });
  return companyData;
}

console.log(company);
```
